thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — we need to finalize dashboard metrics + sharing/RBAC + audit needs for the next feature cut. This is a cross-team ask (runtime, infra, product, security). Can folks list hard requirements and any constraints?

akash: From runtime: we can emit token-level and aggregate metrics. Minimal required: latency_ms, p50/p95/p99, tokens_generated, batch_size, kv_cache_hit_rate, model_variant. Anything else?

juniper: Add: model_version, quantization_flag, routing_policy_id. Those three are required to reproduce regressions. Also we need an event id linking to raw trace for internal only.

elaine: Product constraint: customer-facing dashboards must NOT contain raw prompts or request-level traces by default. External shares should be aggregated or redacted. Internal dashboards can have more detail but we need RBAC gating.

samir: Security: do not expose API keys, raw prompt text, or PII in any external share. Audit logs for share actions must be immutable with 1yr retention for enterprise customers (longer if requested). Use KMS-wrapped keys for exports. Also need a schema for audit events.

akash: Implementation note: runtime currently tags telemetry with `request_id`, `org_id`, `model_name`, `latency_ms`, `route_policy`. We can change to emit `redaction_level` and `masked_user_id` if needed. Removing `prompt_text` from external pipelines is straightforward; internal OLTP will keep full traces behind ACL.

maria: My provisional design: two dashboard modes — internal (full telemetry, traces) and customer-facing (aggregated + redacted). Sharing flow: create a scoped share token that expires, whitelists which metric groups are shared, and records an audit event. Share tokens must be audit-loggable and revocable.

juniper: Example redaction config we can use (simple):
```
redaction: {
  redact_level: "pii", // none | pii | full
  fields_to_strip: ["prompt_text","user_email"],
  keep_sample_ids: true
}
```
This lets us keep request ids for correlation without leaking content.

samir: Audit events must include: user_id, action (create/share/revoke), scope (metric groups), target_org (if external), timestamp, ip, and the share_token_id. Events should be immutable and exported to compliance S3.

elaine: UX ask: when a user creates a share, show a preview of what the external view will look like (with real redaction applied) and a clear PII warning. Default to off for request samples. Also make expiry visible.

akash: Infra note: prefer that sharing jobs read from aggregated OLAP datasets (clickhouse/bigquery) rather than raw traces so we don't accidentally surface prompts. We'll emit separate aggregated datasets keyed by interval and route.

maria: Ok — action items: akash -> produce a metric whitelist + wire format (json) by Thu EOD; samir -> draft audit event schema; juniper -> add redaction config + e2e tests; elaine -> mock UX preview and copy; i'll draft the share-token lifecycle and RBAC policy. Sync Thurs 10am to review.

samir: Also recommend `redact_level` enum in schema {"none","pii","full"} and an org-level policy toggle to allow customers to opt into richer sharing (enterprise only).

juniper: ACK, I'll add tests for opt-in flow and ensure we have a canary that only touches staging.

deploy-bot: rbac-share-v1 pushed to staging-canary at 2026-03-18T20:03:12Z — tag: rbac-share-v1 — status: success (:party_parrot:).

maria: One security nuance — any share that includes request samples must require both a manager approval and 2FA. @samir can you add that to the audit checklist?

samir: On it. I'll add approval + 2FA checks and an IP range validation. Also will propose retention SLAs by tier.

akash: For the metric JSON I'll include this minimal schema snippet so infra knows fields to expect:
```
{
  "metric_name": "latency_ms",
  "aggregation": "p95",
  "dimensions": ["org_id","route_policy"],
  "redaction_level": "pii"
}
```

maria: Great. Final note — export paths must not contain org secret ids or keys. Use opaque token ids. Thanks all, see you Thursday :raised_hands:

elaine: Thanks — will have mock ready.

amaria: Closing thread for now; will follow up with a calendar invite.
